chunks: Ahmad narrated from Ali ibn Asbaat, from one of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Whatever was among our Shias, three things would not be among them: the one who begs in his hand; and there would not be among them a blue-eyed or green-eyed person; and there would not be among them the one who is invited to his behind.
ai.seo_question: What are the three things that will not be found among the Shias according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) delineates three distinct physical or social markers absent among the true Shias: those who beg with an open hand (signifying dependence), those with blue or green eyes (often linked to the Quraysh or specific tribes), and those who are 'anally penetrated' (interpreted by scholars like Al-Majlisi as a sign of humility or being submissive to others). This classification serves to distinguish the Shia community's unique identity and character traits within the broader Islamic society of the time.

en.hubeali:
Ahmad, from Ali Bin Asbaat, from one of our companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Whatever there was among our<sup>asws</sup> Shias, but there will never come to be among them three things – the one who begs in his hand; and there will never be among them a blue-eyed, a green-eyed; and they would not come to be among them the one who invites others to his behind’.
en.sarwar: 9. Ahmad has narrated from Ali ibn Asbat from certain persons of our people who have said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Things may exist in our Shi‘ah, but three things will not be in them, one who stretches his hand for begging, there is no blue or green among them and one who allows sexual intercourse in his anus.’”
